summary_en: One-year rulings for 1975 (Documentorum explanatio « De calendario liturgico anni 1975 », no protocol or date): because 25 March 1975 falls on Tuesday of Holy Week, the solemnity of the Annunciation is celebrated on 7 April 1975, Monday after the Second Sunday of Easter (Normae n. 60); the Commemoration of All the Faithful Departed is kept on Sunday 2 November 1975 at Mass (the Liturgy of the Hours is of the Sunday); and on Sundays 14 September and 9 November 1975 the Exaltation of the Holy Cross and the Dedication of the Lateran Basilica are celebrated.
excerpt: DE CALENDARIO LITURGICO ANNI 1975. 1. Quando celebranda erit sollemnitas Annuntiationis Domini? R. Cum anno 1975, die 25 martii incidat feria III Hebdomadae Sanctae, iuxta tabulam dierum liturgicorum secundum ordinem praecedentiae dispositam et n. 60 Normarum de anno liturgico et de calendario, sollemnitas Annuntiationis Domini celebrabitur die 7 aprilis, feria II post dominicam in Albis.

summary_en: Confirms the election of Blessed Nicholas Saggio as principal patron before God of the city and territory of Longobardi (archdiocese of Cosenza, Italy); a town-level patron, so recorded at level 'other'.
excerpt: Cosentina, 12 octobris 1973 (Prot. n. 857/73): confirmatur electio Beati Nicolai Saggio principalis apud Deum Patroni civitatis ac territorii v. d. « Longobardi ».

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sine labe originali concepta

summary_en: Confirms the election of the Blessed Virgin Mary Immaculately Conceived as patroness before God of the diocesan seminary of the diocese printed as « Ioannopolitana a Lacubus » (probably San Juan de los Lagos, Mexico — nation not printed, left null); a seminary-level patron, recorded at level 'other'.
excerpt: Ioannopolitana a Lacubus, 8 ian. 1974 (Prot. n. 11/74): confirmatur electio Beatae Mariae Virginis sine labe originali conceptae Seminarii dioecesis apud Deum Patronae.

excerpt: Praelatura Pinerensis, 14 nov. 1973 (Prot. n. 1710/73): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Mariae Virginis « Dominae nostrae a SS.mo Corde Iesu », Patronae Praelaturae, die 31 maii quotannis peragi valeat, festo Visitationis B. Mariae V. ad diem 30 maii translato.

summary_en: The Congregation of the Sons of Charity (Canossians) may keep the celebration in honour of Blessed Magdalene of Canossa on 8 May.
excerpt: Congregatio Filiorum a Caritate, 10 dec. 1973 (Prot. n. 1932/73): conceditur ut celebratio in honorem Beatae Magdalenae a Canosa die 8 maii peragi valeat.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Minorum (monasteria monialium II Ordinis Clarissarum-Coletinarum)

summary_en: In all monasteries of the Colettine Poor Clares (Second Order) St Colette may be celebrated on 7 February with the rank of feast.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Minorum, 11 oct. 1973 (Prot. n. 1578/73): conceditur ut in omnibus monasteriis monialium II Ordinis Clarissarum-Coletinarum, die 7 februarii S. Coleta celebrari valeat gradu festi.

celebration.name_latin: Missa votiva « In Conceptione Immaculata B. M. V. »

summary_en: The Oblates of Mary Immaculate may celebrate every year on 17 February, in their oratories and churches, the votive Mass of the Immaculate Conception, unless it falls on a Sunday of Lent; when 17 February is a Sunday in Ordinary Time the faculty is limited to the oratories of the religious family (a fixed-date votive Mass, not a calendar celebration).
excerpt: Congregatio Missionariorum Oblatorum B.M.V. Immaculatae, 12 sept. 1973 (Prot. n. 1241/73): conceditur ut in oratoriis et ecclesiis eiusdem Congregationis die 17 februarii quotannis celebrari valeat Missa votiva « In Conceptione Immaculata B. M. V. », dummodo non occurrat dominica quadragesimae.

excerpt: Congregatio Missionis, 19 oct. 1973 (Prot. n. 1144/73): confirmatur calendarium proprium.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo a Perpetuo Succursu

summary_en: In the religious houses of the Saigon province of the Redemptorists (Vietnam) the solemnity of Our Lady of Perpetual Help may be celebrated on the third day of the lunar new year (« Tet », late January or early February); movable lunar date, so no month/day.
excerpt: Congregatio SS.mi Redemptoris, 30 oct. 1973 (Prot. n. 1514/73): conceditur ut in domibus religiosis Provinciae Saigonensis celebrari valeat tertia die anni novi (scilicet « Tet » secundum calendarium lunare nationis, i.e. in fine mensis ianuarii vel principio februarii), sollemnitas Beatae Mariae Virginis a Perpetuo Succursu.

summary_en: The congregation « Sœurs du Cœur Immaculé de Marie de Blon » (dioecesis Baiocensis) (France) may celebrate every year the solemnity of the Immaculate Heart of the Blessed Virgin Mary on 8 February (one decree for three congregations; this is one of three entries).
excerpt: « Sœurs du Cœur Immaculé de Marie de Blon » (dioecesis Baiocensis); « Filles du Sacré Cœur de Jésus de Coutances » (dioecesis Constantiensis); « Institut du Cœur Immaculé de Marie de Nogent-le-Rotrou » (dioecesis Carnutensis): 11 ian. 1974 (Prot. n. 1981/73): conceditur ipsis Congregationibus ut sollemnitas Cordis Immaculati Beatae Mariae Virginis die 8 februarii quotannis celebrari valeat.

summary_en: In the Dominican Sisters' convent of Corpus Christi at Menlo Park (U.S.A.) the memorial of Our Lady of the Rosary may be celebrated every year on 7 October even when it falls on a Sunday in Ordinary Time; a single-convent concession. The date is printed as « 5 sept. » with no year (the Summarium covers 16 Jul 1973 - 15 Jan 1974), so date is null.
excerpt: Sorores Dominicanae, 5 sept. (Prot. n. 1243/73): conceditur ut in Conventu corporis Christi, loci v.d. « Menlo Park » (U.S.A.), quotannis celebrari valeat die 7 octobris memoria B. Mariae Virginis a Rosario, etiam cum eadem die, dominica temporis « per annum » occurrit.

summary_en: Diocese of Osnabrück (Germany): the title of the parish church of St Joseph in the city of Bremen may be changed to that of St Godehard; a single-church titular change, recorded as 'other' because it alters that church's titular solemnity.
excerpt: Osnabrugensis, 21 iulii 1973 (Prot. n. 1096/73): conceditur ut titulus ecclesiae paroecialis S. Ioseph, in civitate Bremensi, mutari valeat in titulum Sancti Godehardi.

excerpt: Bethlehemensis, 13 maii 1974 (Prot. n. 1451/74): confirmatur electio Beatae Mariae Virginis, sub titulo Immaculati Cordis, principalis apud Deum Patronae dioecesis Bethlehemensis.

summary_en: Netherlands: faculty granted to celebrate the solemnities of the Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary and of All Saints, whenever they do not fall on a Sunday, on the following Sunday, or, when 15 August or 1 November falls on a Monday, on the preceding Sunday; two celebrations, so none is filled.
excerpt: Neerlandia, 28 ian. 1974 (Prot. n. 151/74): conceditur facultas celebrandi sollemnitates Assumptionis Beatae Mariae Virginis et Omnium Sanctorum, quotiescumque die dominica non incidant, dominica sequenti aut, cum dies 15 augusti vel 1 novembris feria II occurrat, dominica antecedenti.

summary_en: In the diocese of São Tomé (São Tomé and Príncipe) the celebration of St Thomas the Apostle may be kept every year on 21 December, provided it does not fall on the Fourth Sunday of Advent.
excerpt: S. Thoma in Insula, 10 iunii 1974 (Prot. n. 1618/74): conceditur ut in dioecesi S. Thomae in Insula celebratio S. Thomae Apostoli peragi valeat quotannis die 21 mensis decembris dummodo non occurrat dominica IV adventus.

target.institute: Congregatio Sublacensis O.S.B. (Abbatia Immaculati Cordis B.M.V. de Belloc)

summary_en: In the Abbey of the Immaculate Heart of Mary of Belloc (Subiaco Congregation, O.S.B., France) the celebration of the patroness may be kept every year on 22 August; a single-abbey concession.
excerpt: Congregatio Sublacensis O.S.B., 6 febr. 1974 (Prot. n. 971/74): conceditur ut in Abbatia Immaculati Cordis B.M.V. de Belloc, eiusdem Congregationis, celebratio Patronae quotannis die 22 augusti peragi valeat.

celebration.name_latin: S. Bonaventura, episcopus et Ecclesiae doctor

summary_en: In the churches and oratories of the Capuchin Friars Minor within the archdiocese of Palermo (Italy) the celebration of St Bonaventure, bishop and doctor of the Church, may be kept every year on 14 July; the faculty may also be used by those in the archdiocese who follow the Order's calendar. A local concession within one archdiocese.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Minorum Capuccinorum, 22 apr. 1974 (Prot. n. 1231/74): conceditur ut in ecclesiis et oratoriis Ordinis Fratrum Minorum Capuccinorum, intra fines Archidioecesis Panormitanae, celebratio S. Bonaventurae, episcopi et Ecclesiae doctoris, die 14 iulii quotannis peragi valeat.

celebration.name_latin: Beati Carmelus Bolta et Franciscus Pinzato, martyres

summary_en: In the proper calendar of the Valencia province of the Friars Minor (Spain) the memorial of Blesseds Carmelo Bolta and Francisco Pinzato, martyrs, is inscribed on 10 July.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Minorum, Provincia Valentina, 6 maii 1974 (Prot. n. 1577/72): conceditur ut in Calendario proprio Provinciae Valentinae in Hispania memoria Beatorum Carmeli Bolta et Francisci Pinzato, martyrum, inscribatur die 10 iulii.

summary_en: The Handmaids of the Child Jesus may keep the celebration of St Raphael the Archangel, patron of the congregation, every year on 24 October.
excerpt: Ancillae a Puero Iesu, 17 maii 1974 (Prot. n. 1518/74): conceditur ut celebratio Sancti Raphaëlis Archangeli, Patroni Congregationis, die 24 octobris quotannis peragi valeat.

target.institute: « Société des Filles du Coeur de Marie »

summary_en: The Society of the Daughters of the Heart of Mary may celebrate every year the solemnity of the Immaculate Heart of the Blessed Virgin Mary on 8 February.
excerpt: « Société des Filles du Coeur de Marie », 29 apr. 1974 (Prot. n. 1492/74): conceditur ut sollemnitas Cordis Immaculati B.M.V., die 8 febr. quotannis celebrari valeat.
